rag-settings.title: Rag settings
rag-settings.debug_info_tooltip: Include Rag debug info in dialog logs (Analytics > Dialogs)
rag-settings.explainability_tooltip: Include RAG explainability instructions in the answering prompt
rag-settings.max_messages_history_label: Max number of messages in history
rag-settings.max_messages_history_info: Number of messages in the dialog history to be taken into account when condensing the question. Zero = no history.
rag-settings.search_type_info: Search method used to retrieve documents from the vector store. Similarity search retrieves chunks by vector proximity (embedding-based). Full text search retrieves chunks by keyword matching within chunk content. Hybrid search combines both. Current support is limited to PGVector.
rag-settings.max_documents_retrieved_info: Maximum number of documents retrieved and passed to the LLM as context. This limit applies to each search type, whether used individually or combined in hybrid mode.
rag-settings.incompatible_provider_error: The file supplied does not reference a compatible provider. Please check the file.
rag-settings.delete_confirmation_message: Are you sure you want to delete the currently saved Rag settings?
rag-settings.unsaved_changes_message: You have unsaved changes. What would you like to do?

prompt-context.title: Rag prompt context
prompt-context.discard_changes_tooltip: Discard changes and revert to last saved state
prompt-context.save_settings_disabled_tooltip: Some lexicon groups have fewer than 2 terms
prompt-context.sticky_info: These elements are injected dynamically into the RAG chain prompt. Changes take effect on new queries after saving.
prompt-context.covered_topics_info_part1: See RAG Topics classification in the
prompt-context.covered_topics_info_part2: view. Note that questions not covered by these topics will still be processed, unless they match an excluded topic below or are specifically handled at the prompt level.
prompt-context.suggested_topics_text: {count, plural, =1 {There is {count} suggested topic} other {There are {count} suggested topics}}
prompt-context.suggested_topics_info: {count, plural, =1 {The following topic was suggested by the RAG chain when it couldn't categorize a conversation based on the covered topics list at the moment of execution. Review and add it to your Covered Topics if relevant to improve future categorization.} other {The following topics were suggested by the RAG chain when it couldn't categorize a conversation based on the covered topics list at the moment of execution. Review and add them to your Covered Topics if relevant to improve future categorization.}}
prompt-context.suggested_topic_tooltip: Click to add this suggested topic to the list of covered topics
prompt-context.excluded_topics_subtitle: Subjects outside the bot's scope of competence
prompt-context.excluded_topics_info: Topics listed here are explicitly mentioned in the prompt as out of scope. The bot will decline questions on these subjects.
prompt-context.business_lexicon_subtitle: Synonym groups and acronym expansions to standardize user queries before search
prompt-context.business_lexicon_info: When a user asks a question, the bot expands it behind the scenes using these groups — replacing or enriching terms with their synonyms and acronym equivalents before searching. This helps surface relevant documents even when the user's wording doesn't exactly match what's written in the knowledge base.
prompt-context.min_terms_warning: A synonym group must contain at least 2 terms.
prompt-context.import_file_label: Rag prompt context settings dump file
prompt-context.topic_conflict_error: An excluded topic with the same name already exists. A topic cannot be both covered and excluded
prompt-context.covered_topic_conflict_error: A covered topic with the same name already exists. A topic cannot be both covered and excluded
prompt-context.dump_provided: Rag prompt context settings dump provided
prompt-context.import_no_data_error: The file provided does not contain the expected data. Please check the file.
